additional_raw_concentrate.notes: Additional terpene upload tab for raw plant material and concentrate/extract.

additional_infused.notes: Additional terpene upload tab for infused products.

full_panel_finished_products_tribal_only.notes: Template has individual terpenes as % but Total Terpenes as mg/g. This mixed-unit profile needs confirmation before automatic export.

rd_terpenes.notes: Mostly %, but Alpha-Humulene appears as ppm in the template; treat as an exception/possible typo.

subcontract_concentrate_extract.notes: Limited analyte set; several in-house analytes are absent.

subcontract_infused.notes: Limited analyte set; several in-house analytes are absent.

subcontract_raw_pm.notes: Limited analyte set; several in-house analytes are absent.

issues_requiring_confirmation.issue: No separate trans-Ocimene row in METRC template
issues_requiring_confirmation.impact: Worksheet can keep cis/trans integration, but METRC export should use one Ocimene field.
issues_requiring_confirmation.recommended_action: Export Ocimene as cis-Ocimene + trans-Ocimene for the selected unit profile.

issues_requiring_confirmation.issue: No separate Trans-Nerolidol row in METRC template
issues_requiring_confirmation.impact: Worksheet can keep cis/trans integration, but METRC uses Cis-Nerolidol plus generic Nerolidol.
issues_requiring_confirmation.recommended_action: Map cis-Nerolidol to Cis-Nerolidol and trans-Nerolidol/Nerolidol 2 to Nerolidol unless method owner requires total Nerolidol.

issues_requiring_confirmation.issue: p-Cymene has both generic Cymene and explicit P-Isopropyltoluene/P-Cymene rows
issues_requiring_confirmation.impact: Using generic Cymene would make the result less specific than the method analyte.
issues_requiring_confirmation.recommended_action: Use P-Isopropyltoluene (P-Cymene) or P. Isopropyltoluene. Ignore generic Cymene unless the method adds generic cymene.

issues_requiring_confirmation.issue: R&D Terpenes Alpha-Humulene unit is ppm
issues_requiring_confirmation.impact: All other Alpha-Humulene terpene rows are % or mg/g. Automatic export may use the wrong unit for R&D.
issues_requiring_confirmation.recommended_action: Confirm whether this is a template typo. If not, add a profile-specific ppm conversion.

issues_requiring_confirmation.issue: Full Panel Finished Products mixed terpene units
issues_requiring_confirmation.impact: Individual terpene rows are %, but Total Terpenes is mg/g.
issues_requiring_confirmation.recommended_action: Keep both % and mg/g in QBench and choose units by export profile. Confirm mixed-unit behavior before enabling automatic Full Panel Finished Products export.

issues_requiring_confirmation.issue: Sub-contract terpene tabs only include a limited analyte set
issues_requiring_confirmation.impact: Guaiol, p-Cymene, Ocimene, Terpinolene, Geraniol, Isopulegol, and others may be absent depending on tab.
issues_requiring_confirmation.recommended_action: Do not force absent analytes into sub-contract sheets. Use only present rows or a separate agreed Other Terpenes rule.

issues_requiring_confirmation.issue: Explicit p-Cymene row is absent from Full Panel Flower
issues_requiring_confirmation.impact: The Full Panel Flower sheet has generic Cymene but not P-Isopropyltoluene (P-Cymene).
issues_requiring_confirmation.recommended_action: Do not map p-Cymene to generic Cymene without compliance approval. Use an additional terpene tab or approve a profile-specific fallback.

issues_requiring_confirmation.issue: Guaiol row is absent from Full Panel Concentrates
issues_requiring_confirmation.impact: The Additional-Terpenes (%) tab includes Guaiol for raw/concentrate, but the Full Panel Concentrates tribal tab does not.
issues_requiring_confirmation.recommended_action: Use the Additional-Terpenes (%) profile for Guaiol or approve an Other Terpenes/profile-specific fallback.
